notes: Added missing storage enforcement, redaction, retention, and monitoring stories to complete audit logging feature.

GOV-F-004-S151.title: Append-Only Storage Enforcement (WORM Semantics)
GOV-F-004-S151.description: Implement persistence layer guarantees that audit records are append-only with no update/delete operations. Enforce via MongoDB schema rules, write-only interface, and repository abstraction that rejects mutations.
GOV-F-004-S151.evidence: Code/Shared/ChatHealthyMongoUtilities.py (write patterns); Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/infrastructure/debug_logger.py (current logging persistence); RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004

GOV-F-004-S152.title: Audit Event Redaction & PII Guard
GOV-F-004-S152.description: Implement pre-write redaction pipeline to remove or mask sensitive data (PII/PHI) from audit payloads while preserving traceability. Integrate with existing de-identification logic where applicable.

GOV-F-004-S153.title: Audit Log Retention & TTL Policy
GOV-F-004-S153.description: Define and implement retention rules for audit logs including TTL indexes for non-critical logs and indefinite retention for compliance-critical events. Ensure no violation of append-only guarantees.
GOV-F-004-S153.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py (data limits/retention patterns); Code/Shared/cost_guard.py (usage tracking lifecycle); RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004

GOV-F-004-S154.title: Audit Logging Monitoring & Alerting Hooks
GOV-F-004-S154.description: Implement metrics and alert hooks for audit pipeline failures, hash validation failures, and logging drop rates. Expose counters for ops visibility without modifying core logging flow.
GOV-F-004-S154.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/pipeline_health.py (monitoring patterns); Code/Shared/ops/dev_pipeline.py (operational hooks); RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004
